KO.rationale: Coca-Cola is a best-in-class consumer franchise with exceptional margins (62% gross, 34% operating, 30% net in Q2 2025), 40%+ global non-alcoholic beverage market share, 64-year dividend streak, and ~$12B guided FCF. Q1 2026 showed accelerating momentum (organic revenue +10%, comparable EPS +18% YoY). However, the stock is quantitatively unattractive at current levels: trailing P/E of 30.0x sits at the absolute ceiling of its 1-year range (23.2x–30.0x), P/B of 12.1x likewise at ceiling, and the entire re-rating has been multiple-driven with flat margins (net margin 25.9%, ROE 40.4% unchanged). The 3.3% trailing earnings yield (or ~3.9% forward using consensus $3.28 EPS) remains below the 10-year Treasury at 4.57%. Price has compounded +12.8% in the latest quarterly period alone, accelerating ahead of fundamentals. The Fairlife ransomware event (July 16, 2026) introduces near-term operational uncertainty with U.S. production suspended and materiality undetermined. The $20B IRS tax dispute remains an unresolved overhang. At 30x trailing earnings for a staples business growing EPS 8-9% organically, the risk/reward is unfavorable — a reversion to the median ~25.5x P/E implies ~15% downside on multiple alone with no earnings change. The stock has priced in perfection.
